claim: Numbered plan docs require index verification: before creating any numbered doc in orama-system/docs/v2/*, read docs/v2/README.md first, use its 'Next free slot' as the coordination lock, create at that slot, then update the README spec tree and advance 'Next free slot' in the same pass. If a wrong-numbered file was created, move content to the correct slot and delete the wrong file.

decisions.notes: Root lesson: do not infer numbering from an uploaded filename or stale conversation context. Recorded 2026-07-04 planning session.
